state_selection: Default states 2,0,1,4: promote state 2 (initial cluster majority digit 2) to the first-page coupling rows as requested; retain fixed states 0,1,4 for comparison. The shown state is not asserted to control the selected trajectory.
state_label_caveat: Labels describe initial clusters; they do not establish the learned states' final class assignments.
interpretation: Learned parameters versus diffusion time, not optimizer iteration or a physical trajectory.
time_order: generation s=t_max-t; stored slice 0 is the noisy end
maps: Raw saved W and Q; no Potts common-mode subtraction or per-frame normalization.
omitted_parameters: Other Potts states, hidden biases, visible on-site linear biases and per-pixel Ising couplings/biases are not shown.
onsite_energy: k_lin*x_i^2/2 + k_duff*x_i^4/4 + bias*x_i (sextic term is zero in this quartic run).
stiffness_caveat: k_lin is a bare coefficient, not the full curvature of the visible energy or marginal free energy.
graph: c_lin is the coefficient of (x_i-x_j)^2, not twice that coefficient (spring stiffness).
spring_map: At pixel i: sqrt(mean over its existing neighbours j of c_ij squared). Magnitude only; not a single edge coefficient.

selection.purpose: Illustrative trajectory ending in a clear digit 2, as explicitly requested by the user.
selection.selection_method: Visually inspected a contact sheet of saved final samples 0 through 99. Index 21 was the first clearly recognizable digit 2; selected for illustration before reproducing its intermediate frames.
selection.interpretation: A visually selected example, not an unbiased sample or evidence of overall model quality.
selection.display: Training-log normalization (mean 0.13142, standard deviation 0.30896), fixed [0,1] grayscale, white digits on black.
selection.state_map_caveat: A digit-2-shaped Potts state and this trajectory are both from the same model. This selection does not establish that one displayed state alone generates the sample.

trajectory_panel.display: clip(x * std + mean, 0, 1); shared grayscale limits, 0 black and 1 white
trajectory_panel.image_interpolation: none; recorded states at exact parameter times, original pixel grid
trajectory_panel.solver_restart: Adaptive solver restarted at every trained parameter knot. Same SDE, Brownian path, tolerances and linear parameter schedule; numerical endpoint need not be bitwise identical to the production solve.

c_lin.threshold_rule: 1% of maximum absolute displayed coefficient in this family

k_lin.threshold_rule: 1% of maximum absolute displayed coefficient in this family

W.threshold_rule: 1% of maximum absolute displayed coefficient in this family

Q.threshold_rule: 1% of maximum absolute displayed coefficient in this family

hidden_colour_scaling: One W scale and one Q scale across all displayed states, times and pages.
parameter_colormap: RdBu_r for every parameter family, including positive-only rows
colour_interpretation: Blue to red means low to high within each row's numerical range; blue is not a universal negative-value marker. White is zero for symmetric signed rows, but the geometric midpoint for positive log rows.

artwork.displayed_time: forward time t only; decreases left to right
artwork.figure_notes: In caption and provenance, not on the artwork
